scenes.text: Your backtest and your live system are usually two different codebases. That's why they drift.
With Wingfoil you describe it once, in Rust. Split a stream into branches, merge them back, then run it.
Under the hood it's a graph. The engine runs each node once per cycle, even where branches recombine.
Run it historically, and it's an instant, deterministic replay for backtests.
Run the same graph live, and it's paced by the wall clock. Same values, same order. Only the clock changes.
One definition. A backtest and a live system that can't drift.
